shortDescription: Adds IKEA-themed cosmetic body genes to OMW Storageborn Xenotype, including Blåhaj Blast and FraktaRainbow’s one-day RainMaker.
body:
## IKEA Storageborn body genes

Requires and loads after OMW Storageborn Xenotype. Defines six `GeneDef`s extending `OMW_StorageBodyBase`: Blåhaj, Frakta, and FraktaRainbow are in the Industrial Ikea category; Kallax, Billy, and Lack are in the Medieval Ikea category. Each assigns a corresponding childhood backstory, uses matching body texture paths for all body types through a BigAndSmall pawn extension, and gives its defined Storageborn gene package (including optional Alpha Genes entries). FraktaRainbow additionally forces the Gay trait.

## Blahaj Blast ability

The Blåhaj body gene grants `OMW_BlahajBlast`, a single-pawn targeted ability with a 300-tick (5-second) cooldown. It plays the custom `OMW_BlahajBlastSound` SoundDef backed by the WAV in `Sounds/Abilities/BlahajBlast.wav`, deals 15 bullet damage, and adds `VU_Hermaphromorph` to a targeted pawn as a xenogene if they do not already have that gene. The SoundDef uses `AudioGrain_Folder` to load from the containing folder, avoiding the asset scanner's `<clipPath>` stub generation. Its beam effect draws layered blue, pink, and white flecks, with white inside, pink middle, and light blue outside, using a dedicated white fleck texture tinted per layer.

## RainMaker ability

The FraktaRainbow body gene grants `OMW_RainMaker`. Activating it creates a map game condition that forces vanilla Rain for 60,000 ticks (one in-game day). The ability cooldown is also 60,000 ticks. The condition is registered on the caster's map.

## Categories and art

Defines Medieval Ikea and Industrial Ikea Storageborn categories with medieval and industrial world tech levels. Ships north, south, and east body textures for Blåhaj, Billy, Frakta, FraktaRainbow, Kallax, and Lack; gene icons point to the corresponding south-facing textures.
